actions.command:
cd /app && (qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,media=cdrom,readonly=on -boot d -net none >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/alpine-qemu.pid) && sleep 2 && python3 - <<'PY'
import socket,sys,time
host='127.0.0.1'; port=6665
end=time.time()+60
buf=b''
while time.time()<end:
    try:
        s=socket.create_connection((host,port),timeout=2)
        s.settimeout(2)
        for _ in range(20):
            try:
                data=s.recv(4096)
                if not data:
                    break
                buf += data
                if b'login:' in buf.lower():
                    print(buf.decode('utf-8','replace'))
                    sys.exit(0)
            except socket.timeout:
                pass
        s.close()
    except Exception:
        pass
    time.sleep(1)
print(buf.decode('utf-8','replace'))
sys.exit(1)
PY

actions.content: Started QEMU in background with Alpine ISO and telnet serial on 127.0.0.1:6665; probing for login prompt and will preserve running instance if successful.
